LanguageData.HR_Research_BasicFarming.description: Unlocks the handcraft table for processing agricultural and craft materials. Historical horizon: early farming evidence spans roughly 8000–5000 BCE; this is not a precise invention date.
LanguageData.HR_Research_AnimalHusbandry.description: Unlocks assignable straw animal beds. Early domestication dates vary by region, broadly spanning 9000–5000 BCE.
LanguageData.HR_Research_SeedSelection.description: Unlocks rice and corn seed sorting recipes. The resulting stock can be stored or traded; no seed genetics simulation is included.
LanguageData.HR_Research_GrainStorage.description: Unlocks a grain shelf and recipes that dry and bundle grain. Storage practices developed gradually with agriculture.
LanguageData.HR_Research_Irrigation.description: Unlocks irrigated field terrain with 1.15 fertility for improved crop growth. This simplified feature does not simulate channel flow.
LanguageData.HR_Research_BronzeAlloy.description: Unlocks a recipe combining copper and tin into bronze. Proportions are a simplified gameplay model; early bronze horizons vary by region.
LanguageData.HR_Research_BronzeCasting.description: Unlocks production of a bronze family vessel, a physical item that can be stored and entered in the relic archive. Early casting dates vary by region.
LanguageData.HR_Research_BronzeTools.description: Unlocks a bronze adze that can be equipped and used in melee combat.
LanguageData.HR_Research_EarlyIronworking.description: Unlocks iron-bearing stone sorting, the bloomery forge, and bloomery iron smelting. Proposed early horizons remain regionally disputed.
LanguageData.HR_Research_Pottery.description: Unlocks clay preparation and a basic pottery recipe at the handcraft table. Pottery evidence predates 10000 BCE in some regions.
LanguageData.HR_Research_Weaving.description: Unlocks the hand loom and converts plant fibre into cloth for crafting and trade.
LanguageData.HR_Research_IronFarmTools.description: Unlocks an early iron adze that can be equipped and used in melee combat.
LanguageData.HR_Research_KilnFiring.description: Unlocks the pottery kiln and a higher-yield controlled-firing recipe.
LanguageData.HR_Research_PlantFibres.description: Unlocks a recipe that prepares plant fibre from hay for use at the hand loom.
LanguageData.HR_Research_RammedEarth.description: Unlocks rammed-earth walls that block movement, support roofs, and resist fire better than timber walls.
LanguageData.HR_Research_BowMaking.description: Unlocks a craftable and equipable simple hunting bow for hunting and defense.
LanguageData.HR_Research_Writing.description: Unlocks production of physical inscribed clay tablets for storage and trade; this does not replace the in-game chronicle.
LanguageData.HR_Research_WaterManagement.description: Unlocks water-managed field terrain with 1.30 fertility for improved crop growth. Wells, drainage networks, and dynamic water flow are not simulated.
LanguageData.HR_Research_Commerce.description: Unlocks a regional trade bundle recipe that packs pottery and cloth into a higher-value caravan good; vanilla trader generation is unchanged.
